name: LBS
recent: LBS Bina 在 2026 年 11 月公布第三季度业绩，并持续进行股票回购。公司也宣布将 sukuk 计划规模扩大至 RM1.5 billion，同时推介 RM8.3 billion 的 The Reserva 发展项目。
notable: 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，9M26 税后归属股东净利 (PATMI) 为 RM48.7 million。
将 sukuk 计划规模扩大至 RM1.5 billion。
推介 RM8.3 billion 的 The Reserva 发展项目，首阶段预计 2027 年 4 月推出。
risks: 集团执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San 在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
公司近期持续进行股票回购。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM340.464 million，环比增长 14.8%，同比增长 9.9%；净利为 RM15.049 million，环比下降 11.6%，同比下降 44.4%，净利率为 4.4%。

recent_en: LBS Bina announced its 3Q 2026 results in November 2026 and continued its share buyback. The company also expanded its sukuk programme to RM1.5 billion and unveiled the RM8.3 billion The Reserva development.
notable_en: Announced 3Q 2026 results with 9M26 PATMI of RM48.7 million.
Doubled its sukuk programme size to RM1.5 billion.
Unveiled the RM8.3 billion The Reserva development, with the first phase targeted for launch in April 2027.
risks_en: Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
The company has been conducting share buybacks recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM340.464 million, up 14.8% QoQ and 9.9% YoY; net income was RM15.049 million, down 11.6% QoQ and 44.4% YoY, with a net margin of 4.4%.
